newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares ease back slightly from new high.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares ease back slightly from new high.

text.p: Jakarta shares continued in record territory on Thursday, with the index touching a new high of 704.31 before easing back to 703.41 on profit-taking in blue chips, brokers said.
The index was up 2.36 points, or 0.34 percent, at the lunch break, with gainers leading losers 55 to 39, and 42 counters unchanged.

Brokers said the market was likely to move in a narrow range in the afternoon session with many players taking a cautious attitude after the index broke through the psychological 700 barrier on Wednesday.
"Some profit-taking might continue in the second-session but it will be in limited amounts," a foreign broker said.
Bank Negara Indonesia topped the active list with 12.4 million shares changing hands. Its price was unchanged at 1,700 rupiah after touching a high of 1,725 rupiah.
Some profit-taking in heavyweights Telkom and BNI weighed on the index to prevent it increasing further, brokers said.
Telkom traded unchanged at 4,225 rupiah on 1.3 million shares after rising to 4,250 rupiah. Indosat was up 175 rupiah to 7,150 rupiah on 1.4 million shares.
Lippo Bank rose 12 percent to 2,800 rupiah on a volume of 3.9 million shares.
Brokers said this was partly linked to a report that its floating rate certificates of deposit issue has been increased to US$60 million from US$50 million due to oversubscription.
